evidence_rule: PASS requires the evidence listed by the test. PENDING is the default. Automated preparation evidence never substitutes for real/manual acceptance evidence.

tests.action: Sign in with a VIEWER-only user and open BCSentinel pages, scan/history, setup and scheduler entry points.
tests.expected: Read-only pages are accessible; scan execution, setup changes and scheduling are denied or unavailable.
evidence: screenshot of denied or unavailable write/admin action

tests.action: Sign in with a scan-capable non-admin user and execute an allowed scan; attempt setup/scheduler administration.
tests.expected: Allowed scan completes and history is visible; setup/scheduler administration remains denied unless separately entitled.
evidence: completed scan screenshot with run identifier

tests.action: Sign in with setup permission and change a reversible BCSentinel setup value; verify unrelated admin capabilities remain bounded.
tests.expected: Permitted setup change saves successfully and role does not gain unrelated administration rights.

tests.action: Create or edit a reversible BCSentinel schedule and verify scan scheduling permissions without granting full setup/admin rights.
tests.expected: Schedule operation succeeds; broader administration remains denied.

tests.action: Exercise setup, scan, history, exceptions, notification settings and scheduling as ADMIN.
tests.expected: All intended administrative capabilities are available and complete without permission errors.
evidence: screenshots covering setup, scan/history, exceptions/notifications and schedule

tests.action: Run a real scan through completion and inspect scan history, findings and actions.
tests.expected: Scan completes once, appears in history, findings are consistent with the run and actions can be reviewed according to permissions.

tests.action: Create or use an active BC exception, run a scan, then inspect the web exception indicator/drilldown for that scan.
tests.expected: The applied exception is captured immutably for the scan and shown read-only on the web; later BC exception edits do not rewrite the historical snapshot.
evidence: second screenshot after BC exception change proving historical immutability

tests.action: Trigger the conditions for a configured BCSentinel notification and inspect the resulting runtime state/log.
tests.expected: Notification logic respects configuration, language and permissions without duplicate or phantom events.

tests.action: Complete a checkout using canonical list pricing for one supported paid product/tier.
tests.expected: Stripe amount, product/tier metadata, tenant identity and resulting entitlement match the canonical server-side price.

tests.action: Apply one approved tenant commercial override and complete checkout.
tests.expected: Effective server-side price matches the override, canonical list price remains traceable and no unintended stacking occurs.

tests.action: Complete an eligible list-price checkout using a Stripe promotion code.
tests.expected: Promotion applies only where allowed, resulting amount is correct and tenant override stacking rules are enforced.

tests.action: Provision a sponsored/zero-price pilot using the governed tenant commercial path without Stripe checkout.
tests.expected: Entitlement becomes active according to the sponsored terms, with audit trail and without a fake zero-price Stripe subscription.

tests.action: Verify successful payment, failed payment, customer portal access, cancellation and invoice/webhook handling using Stripe test mode.
tests.expected: Subscription and entitlement states track authoritative provider events idempotently and cancellation/failure boundaries behave as designed.

tests.action: Send a German test email from the admin preview/test-send flow to an external mailbox.
tests.expected: Message is received with correct sender, German template, rendered placeholders and no script/template leakage.

tests.action: Send an English test email and verify language selection/fallback.
tests.expected: English version is delivered and fallback behavior matches the configured language contract.

tests.action: Verify production-intended sender-domain SPF, DKIM and DMARC alignment using a received test email.
tests.expected: Authentication results are aligned and no sender-domain configuration error is present.

tests.action: Take a real off-host backup artifact, verify checksum, restore it into an isolated target and start the restored service/database safely.
tests.expected: Restore succeeds from the independently stored artifact, schema is at the intended revision and selected probe data is intact.

tests.action: Record timestamps for backup availability, restore start and restored-service readiness during the real recovery exercise.
tests.expected: Measured recovery evidence is recorded for later RTO/RPO sign-off; no target is invented if none is contractually approved yet.

tests.surface: public DEV + Business Central + web dashboard
tests.action: Follow the real pilot path from landing/pilot request through account login, tenant selection, BC connection/scan, dashboard, Executive Report and Monitoring.
tests.expected: One coherent tenant-scoped journey completes without manual data repair or hidden admin shortcuts.

tests.actor: one account with memberships in two tenants
tests.action: Switch between two real test tenants with different roles/entitlements and inspect protected data/features in each.
tests.expected: New tenant session is minted on each switch; roles/entitlements and all visible data follow the active tenant with no cross-tenant leakage.

tests.action: Run the approved real soak workload for approximately 24 hours while collecting health, error and resource evidence.
tests.expected: No P0/P1 isolation, stability or unbounded-resource issue appears; any lower-severity finding is documented for disposition.

tests.action: Exercise concurrent tenant activity at the agreed pilot scale while sampling tenant switching and protected reads.
tests.expected: Tenant isolation remains intact under load and no session/entitlement crossover occurs.

tests.action: Review landing, pilot, dashboard core/service pages and report surfaces at desktop width against the frozen Product System.
tests.expected: No material token, navigation, overflow, clipped content, stale pricing/claims or phantom-feature discrepancy remains.

tests.action: Review landing, pilot and web dashboard at representative mobile width(s), including navigation, tables/cards, dialogs and tenant switcher.
tests.expected: No blocking horizontal overflow, inaccessible control, clipped value or unusable navigation remains.

tests.action: Generate a representative Executive Report PDF and inspect every page at normal viewing/print scale.
tests.expected: Branding, pagination, tables, financial semantics, exception appendix and disclaimers are readable and no content overlaps/cuts off.
evidence: accepted PDF artifact or page screenshots

tests.action: Inspect the production environment and deployment protection configuration.
tests.expected: PROD remains manual-only and the intended production-environment protection/approval boundary is configured before release authorization.

tests.action: Review all E3-E7 evidence, unresolved findings and the generated immutable RC manifest before explicitly approving a release candidate.
tests.expected: RC freeze is authorized only when all required gates are PASS and no blocking finding remains; selected release ref is immutable and recorded.

tests.action: Authorize the controlled pilot only after the approved RC and all prerequisite manual/external evidence are complete.
tests.expected: Pilot authorization references the exact approved release and defined pilot scope; it does not imply unrestricted GA/production readiness.
